errors.text: The proposed SPD-plus-annealing route does not reconstruct the decisive 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2-hour HPHT treatment.
The initial FCC/B2 eutectic lamellar structure and its incoherent, crack-prone interfaces are not identified.
The hypothesis assumes coherent nanoprecipitation without compositional or experimental evidence that the alloy can form such precipitates under the proposed annealing conditions.
The proposed mechanism omits the central transition to a hierarchical microstructure with coherent FCC/B2 interfaces and preferential dislocation transfer between phases.
Orowan bypass is invoked for coherent nanoscale precipitates, although coherent, sufficiently small precipitates are commonly sheared rather than bypassed.
The predicted improvements are generic and substantially underspecify the observed approximately 1150 MPa strength and 36% uniform elongation.
